attacks.name: Hex Bolt
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!failure| |*Chaos Magic|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!failure| in the attack roll, the defender gains one of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§hex§Hex|, |§incinerate§Incinerate|, or |§poison§Poison|.

attacks.name: Cruel Twist
steps: The defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes and cannot add additional dice to its defense roll as a result of |!critical| results.
|!failure| |*Reality Contortion|: Change one of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

superPowers.name: Telekinesis
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Curse
superPowers.body: When this character is damaged by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, it may use this superpower. The character that caused the effect gains the |§judgment§Judgment| special condition.

superPowers.name: Chosen of Chthon
superPowers.body: When attacking, defending, or dodging, this character adds |!failure| results in its rolls to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Hex Field
superPowers.body: Enemy characters performing a Shake action while within |!range| 3 of this character may not remove the |§hex§Hex|, |§judgment§Judgment|, or |§poison§Poison| special conditions.
